notes.title: The August Before: Chapter One is available now for free!
notes.content:
The August Before: Chapter One is out now!

You can now play The August Before: Chapter One for free! We're really looking forward to your feedback and hope you enjoy the first chapter in August's story. You can leave a review to give your feedback and help us as we continue developing the full game. 

Play The August Before: Chapter One for free now from the widget below!

steam://openurl/https://store.steampowered.com/app/2516940/The_August_Before_Chapter_One/?snr=1_5_1100__1100&utm_source=steamwidget

Please don't forget to wishlist The August Before if you enjoy the prologue version! Wishlists are much appreciated as they help us show our game to more people and let us know you're interested in our game.


What was added to The August Before: Chapter One?

Since our previous publically available version, we've made a lot of improvements and additions to the game. You can find a list of these changes below.


Gameplay

 Added transition to the new room
 You can now carry multiple objects at once
 You can't take it all with you — now your goal is not only to pack everything in your suitcase; you will have to choose what to take
 You don't need to zoom items in or out to put them in place
 Excessive UI-elements removed


UX

 3 more crosshair options
 New menu interactions
 New tutorial steps
 new VFX
 Mouse sensitivity settings added
 Animations for all items
 Hints-mode is available


Visual

 New textures (photos, books, magazines)
 New objects
 Second room preview
 New character-related objects
 Reworked existing objects and minor adjustments to textures, colors, and other details


SFX

 New in-game music
 New sound effects


Bugs

 Objects do not overlap with each other
 Objects do not fall through surfaces
 Objects are not clipping
 Light and shadows are not flickering when set on low graphics mode
 Photo album bugs fixed
 All objects on the pin board can be examined
 Other small bugs
